tickets.help.title: Tickets & Features
tickets.help.intro: This board brings Zoho Desk tickets and GitHub pull requests together behind one front door. Use it to filter what is urgent, see the real context, and start work without colliding with someone else.
tickets.help.first.title: Getting started
tickets.help.first.step1: Choose Active or Resolved and filter by lane, owner, or Mine.
tickets.help.first.step2: Tap a ticket or PR card to open its full detail in a modal.
tickets.help.first.step3: Tap Claim before working so everyone else can see that it is in use.
tickets.help.first.step4: Review the description, status, conversations, CI, additional context, and history available for that item type.
tickets.help.first.step5: Tap Continue/Work in chat to start with all that context, or open Zoho/GitHub to consult the source.

tickets.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
tickets.help.buttons.dashboard.v: Opens the board in a modal and reads the shared Zoho/GitHub snapshot, updated every 60 seconds. It is deterministic: it uses no AI and consumes no tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.search.v: Opens a field: type the number and press Enter to go straight to the ticket.
tickets.help.buttons.refresh.v: Admin only: forces a reread from Zoho/GitHub. Everyone else sees the shared snapshot, updated every 60 seconds.
tickets.help.buttons.lane.v: Filter cards by category; tap the active lane again in the overview to remove the filter.
tickets.help.buttons.mine.v: Shows only the items you have claimed.
tickets.help.buttons.owner.v: Filters tickets by Desk agent and PRs by GitHub author.
tickets.help.buttons.views.v: Switches between open queues and the persistent store of closed tickets and merged PRs.
tickets.help.buttons.all.v: Opens a wide table with all queues combined and honors the active filters.
tickets.help.buttons.expand.v: Opens every ticket in that queue in a sortable table; “+N more” does the same.
tickets.help.buttons.block.v: Opens or closes the card block.
tickets.help.buttons.card.v: Opens the detail with properties, source, context, and available actions.
tickets.help.buttons.table.v: Filters by number/subject and sorts when you tap any heading; a row opens its detail.
tickets.help.buttons.claim.v: Marks the item as yours to prevent duplicate work. Uses no tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.release.v: Releases an item you had claimed. Uses no tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.steal.v: Transfers an item claimed by someone else to you after confirmation.
tickets.help.buttons.force.v: Admin only: removes another person's lock.
tickets.help.buttons.detailRefresh.v: Rereads that ticket or PR from its source. Uses no AI tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.chat.v: Opens an AI runner with the item's detail, context, and history. CONSUMES TOKENS; if it was free, it also claims it automatically.
tickets.help.buttons.github.v: Opens GitHub in another tab. Starts no AI and uses no tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.zoho.v: Opens the ticket's original source in another tab. Uses no tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.contextOpen.v: Expands the field where you paste a transcript; opening it uses no tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.interpret.v: Starts an AI runner and saves the result as additional context. CONSUMES TOKENS and asks for confirmation.
tickets.help.buttons.edit.v: Loads the existing context into the field and saves it directly, with no AI or tokens.
tickets.help.buttons.delete.v: Deletes the saved additional context after confirmation.
tickets.help.buttons.history.v: Expands a previous session's summary and files; generated when the chat closes without using AI.
tickets.help.warning.title: Watch out
tickets.help.warning.locks: Stealing or forcing a release changes who can work on the item; Delete context removes the persisted note. All three ask for confirmation, but coordinate before overriding someone else's work.
tickets.help.warning.sources: Zoho may limit resolved loads to roughly 100 rows per department, and the board keeps stale data when a source fails: check ◷, ⚠️, and the snapshot time before deciding.
tickets.help.warning.meta: Additional context and Work history are per-item metadata stored in the local Pad; they are not files and do not modify the original ticket or PR.
tickets.help.warning.pad: A PR's Pad data depends on an OAuth token that lasts around one hour and has no refresh of its own; if stale, GitHub and Zoho remain the sources to verify.
